map.按 BCP 47：语言子标签（zh）+ 可选书写系统（Hans/Hant）+ 可: Per BCP 47: a language subtag (zh) + an optional script (Hans/Hant) + an optional region (CN/TW). If you only care about simplified vs. traditional, use zh-Hans; if you need to distinguish regional conventions, use zh-CN. Server-side matching should fall back step by step (zh-Hans-CN → zh-Hans → zh), or users will unexpectedly drop to the default language.
